links.effect: PancreaGuide-integrated models scored higher on all 5 dimensions; Gemini+ mean 3.88 (SD 0.38) vs DeepSeek base 2.31 (SD 0.58); largest gains in completeness and robustness. No component ablation.

links.outcome: CT report interpretation accuracy against surgery-based proxy reference, base vs integrated
links.effect: Accuracy rose from 80.0% to 85.8% (ChatGPT), 67.6% to 74.3% (DeepSeek), 80.9% to 87.4% (Gemini); 95% CIs generally overlapped.
links.quote: After integration, accuracy increased to 85.8% (381/444) for ChatGPT+, 74.3% (330/444) for DeepSeek+, and 87.4% (388/444) for Gemini+.

links.effect: PancreaGuide-integrated models still produced 233 model-case error events for FP and FN classifications.
links.quote: A total of 233 error events were independently reviewed by 2 senior pancreatic surgeons and assigned to predefined error-source categories.

links.effect: Ambiguous vascular involvement accounted for 31.3% of both FN and FP error categories.
links.quote: Ambiguous vascular involvement was the most frequent source of both FN and FP events, accounting for 31.3% of errors in each category.

links.effect: Best integrated model accuracy was 87.4% (388/444), sensitivity 95.9%, specificity 76.9%, leaving false classifications.
links.quote: Gemini+ demonstrated the highest classification accuracy at 87.4% (388/444), with a sensitivity of 95.9% and a specificity of 76.9%.
